organize.otoroshi.io.Organization.description: An organization, also called a tenant: the top level partition of otoroshi. Every entity belongs to one organization (its `_loc.tenant`), and admins are granted rights per organization and team. The same entities are served as `organizations` and as `tenants`

id.description: The id of the organization, the value of `_loc.tenant` of its entities. It is lowercased and trimmed when read

name.description: The name of the organization, for humans. Defaults to the id

description.description: A free text describing the organization, shown and searched in the list of the organizations of the backoffice. Empty when absent
description.example: The organization of the ACME teams

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the organization

tags.description: Free tags of the organization, to search and sort it

_loc.description: The location of the organization, written by otoroshi from its id: an organization is in itself, with no team. It is not read back

example.name: ACME Corp.
example.description: The organization of the ACME teams

organize.otoroshi.io.ServiceGroup.description: A service group: a set of routes, apis and route compositions that api keys can be authorized on as a whole. A route belongs to the groups listed in its `groups`, an api key authorized on a group can call all of them

id.description: The id of the group, referenced by the `groups` of the routes and the authorizations of the api keys (`group_<id>`)

name.description: The display name of the group, shown and searched in the list of the service groups of the backoffice

description.description: A free text describing the group, shown and searched in the list of the service groups of the backoffice. Empty when absent
description.example: The apis of the billing domain

tags.description: Free tags of the group, to search and sort it

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the group

example.name: billing-apis
example.description: The apis of the billing domain

organize.otoroshi.io.Team.description: A team of an organization: a partition of the entities of the organization (their `_loc.teams`). Admins are granted rights per organization and team

id.description: The id of the team, the value listed in `_loc.teams` of its entities. It is lowercased and trimmed when read, and unique within its organization

tenant.description: The id of the tenant (organization) the team belongs to. It is lowercased and trimmed when read

name.description: The name of the team, for humans. Defaults to the id

description.description: A free text describing the team, shown and searched in the list of the teams of the backoffice. Empty when absent
description.example: The team running the payment apis

metadata.description: Free key/value metadata of the team

tags.description: Free tags of the team, to search and sort it

_loc.description: The location of the team, written by otoroshi from its tenant (organization) and its id: a team is in its organization and in itself. It is not read back

example.name: Payments
example.description: The team running the payment apis
